answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable work-bond in a shared vault before its votes or rewards count, and release that bond only after several unrelated peers attest a unit of real work. Raise the bond with every extra identity from the same collateral, so a farm pays retail for each mask. Draw those peers from far-apart slices of the network, the way water finds separate chambers in a karst, and have them read a short public challenge the way a cutter studies a pearl: slowly, under light, with a slash if they rubber-stamp junk. Mass fake identities then cost more than they can steal.
